name: Ingest runs (latest first)
sql: SELECT run_id, started_at, finished_at, source, status, json_extract(stats_json,'$.seconds') AS seconds FROM ingest_run ORDER BY run_id DESC

name: Coverage of the latest run
sql: SELECT metric, numerator, denominator, round(100.0*numerator/denominator,1) AS pct, note FROM coverage WHERE run_id=(SELECT max(run_id) FROM ingest_run WHERE status='ok') ORDER BY rowid

name: Sheet stations not matched to OSM
sql: SELECT s.name, l.name AS line, s.match_status, s.match_note FROM scope_station s LEFT JOIN scope_line l USING(line_id) WHERE s.match_status NOT IN ('matched','manual') ORDER BY l.name, s.line_seq

name: Sheet stations by line with OSM ids
sql: SELECT l.name AS line, s.line_seq, s.name, s.zone, s.osm_type, s.osm_id, round(s.lat,5) AS lat, round(s.lon,5) AS lon FROM scope_station s LEFT JOIN scope_line l USING(line_id) ORDER BY l.name, s.line_seq

name: Track km by type, usage and service
sql: SELECT railway, state, coalesce(usage,'-') AS usage, coalesce(service,'-') AS service, count(*) AS ways, round(sum(length_m)/1000,2) AS km FROM rail_track GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY km DESC

name: Running lines missing a speed limit
sql: SELECT way_id, ref, name, usage, round(length_m) AS length_m FROM rail_track WHERE state='present' AND service IS NULL AND railway IN ('rail','narrow_gauge') AND coalesce(maxspeed,maxspeed_forward,maxspeed_backward) IS NULL ORDER BY length_m DESC

name: Speed profile (km by maxspeed)
sql: SELECT coalesce(maxspeed, maxspeed_forward) AS maxspeed_kmh, count(*) AS ways, round(sum(length_m)/1000,2) AS km FROM rail_track WHERE state='present' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

name: Electrification summary
sql: SELECT coalesce(electrified,'(untagged)') AS electrified, voltage, frequency, round(sum(length_m)/1000,2) AS km FROM rail_track WHERE state='present' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY km DESC

name: Train protection by system
sql: SELECT coalesce(train_protection,'(none tagged)') AS system, count(*) AS ways, round(sum(length_m)/1000,2) AS km FROM rail_track WHERE state='present' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY km DESC

name: Gauge summary
sql: SELECT coalesce(gauge,'(untagged)') AS gauge, round(sum(length_m)/1000,2) AS km FROM rail_track WHERE state='present' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY km DESC

name: Signals by category and type
sql: SELECT category, json_extract(categories_json,'$."railway:signal:'||category||'"') AS type, count(*) AS signals, sum(direction IS NULL) AS no_direction FROM rail_signal GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY signals DESC

name: Switches with their legs
sql: SELECT s.node_id, s.ref, s.switch_type, s.turnout_side, l.leg, l.trunk_edge, l.branch_edge, l.angle_deg FROM rail_switch s LEFT JOIN topo_switch_leg l ON l.switch_node=s.node_id ORDER BY s.ref, l.leg DESC

name: Untagged junctions (inferred switches)
sql: SELECT node_id, degree, round(lat,6) AS lat, round(lon,6) AS lon FROM topo_node WHERE kind='junction' ORDER BY degree DESC

name: Shunting localities: yards, sidings and spurs
sql: SELECT service, coalesce(name, ref) AS label, count(*) AS ways, round(sum(length_m)) AS metres FROM rail_track WHERE service IN ('yard','siding','spur') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY metres DESC

name: Stations with platform count
sql: SELECT s.name, s.kind, count(p.osm_id) AS platforms, group_concat(p.ref, ', ') AS refs FROM rail_station s LEFT JOIN rail_platform p ON p.station_osm_type=s.osm_type AND p.station_osm_id=s.osm_id WHERE s.kind IN ('station','halt') GROUP BY s.osm_type, s.osm_id ORDER BY s.name

name: Railway POIs by kind
sql: SELECT kind, count(*) AS n FROM rail_feature GROUP BY kind ORDER BY n DESC

name: Routes and path completeness
sql: SELECT relation_id, name, ref, network, path_status, path_gaps, round(path_length_m/1000,2) AS km, stop_count FROM rail_route ORDER BY path_status, name

name: Sheet lines mapped to OSM routes
sql: SELECT l.name AS line, l.colour, count(x.relation_id) AS routes, group_concat(r.name, ' | ') AS route_names FROM scope_line l LEFT JOIN scope_line_route x USING(line_id) LEFT JOIN rail_route r USING(relation_id) GROUP BY l.line_id ORDER BY l.name

name: Features placed along edges (linear referencing)
sql: SELECT e.way_id, f.edge_id, f.feature_kind, f.osm_type, f.osm_id, round(f.offset_m,1) AS offset_m, round(f.snap_m,1) AS snap_m, f.facing FROM topo_edge_feature f JOIN topo_edge e USING(edge_id) ORDER BY e.way_id, f.edge_id, f.offset_m

name: Hand-made rows (negative ids)
sql: SELECT 'osm_node' AS tbl, count(*) AS n FROM osm_node WHERE id<0 UNION ALL SELECT 'osm_way', count(*) FROM osm_way WHERE id<0 UNION ALL SELECT 'rail_station', count(*) FROM rail_station WHERE osm_id<0 UNION ALL SELECT 'rail_signal', count(*) FROM rail_signal WHERE node_id<0

name: Raw OSM tag keys on railway nodes
sql: SELECT j.key, count(*) AS uses FROM osm_node, json_each(osm_node.tags) AS j WHERE osm_node.tags <> '{}' GROUP BY j.key ORDER BY uses DESC LIMIT 200

name: Most called queries (query log)
sql: SELECT database, name, call_count, last_called_at, last_source FROM saved_query ORDER BY call_count DESC LIMIT 100
